en: Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone town square with a large historic building on the right featuring a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and a tall clock tower with an open belfry and spire. Several other steep‑roofed buildings surround the square, and multiple church spires rise in the background. People stand and walk around the mostly empty square, with simple streetlamps and low wheeled carts in the foreground. The scene has an early‑20th‑century feel.
